windows.releaseNotes:
## Reset notifications

- Make five-hour and seven-day quota reset alerts reliably catch up after missed deadlines, restarts, and legacy state migration.
- Deliver reset alerts through the Windows notification center and retry transient notification failures until delivery succeeds.

android.releaseNotes:
## Launcher icon

- Restore the launcher artwork from the original dashboard SVG with crisp, scalable vector geometry.
- Keep the standard, round, themed, and startup artwork visually consistent while giving the mark more balanced surrounding space.
